offers.name: LG Gram 16" OLED 120Hz HDR Laptop - Intel Core Ultra 7 155H - 16GB LPDDR5X - 512GB SSD - Obsidian Black

reviews.quote: LG Gram 16 16T90P Convertible Review: Lighter than most 15.6-inch laptops — the OLED gram 16 is incredibly thin and light for its class.

praises: OLED 120 Hz panel with true blacks at clearance pricing — widely called the best display dollar in the gram line
Still ~1.19 kg: a 16-inch OLED ultrabook lighter than most 14-inch laptops
Meteor Lake 155H is a genuine 16-core part for mixed productivity
Full port set (HDMI, USB-A, microSD, dual TB4) despite the thin chassis
HDR media playback on OLED is excellent for streaming
complaints: Meteor Lake battery is the weakest of recent grams — users report ~7-8h, well under LG claims
16GB soldered RAM with no upgrade path
OLED glossy panel reflects heavily in bright rooms
Lid flex and thin-speaker compromises same as every gram
2024 panel: no Copilot+ NPU certification and Wi-Fi 6E only, so it ages faster than 2025 models

design_philosophy: The 2024 gram 16 OLED pairs the line's magnesium-nano-carbon featherweight chassis with its best display technology — a 120 Hz OLED in a 1.19 kg 16-inch shell. At $1,250 clearance it is the standout value pick of the whole 2026 gram retail shelf, trading last-gen Meteor Lake efficiency and 16GB RAM for a screen that outclasses current mid-tier grams.
